description: This file defines an abstract base class for wizard pages in the setup flow of the AnySoftKeyboard app, handling UI initialization, permission results, and interaction with the parent activity.

classes.name: WizardPageBaseFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class serving as a base for wizard pages in the setup process, managing UI layout, permissions, and interaction with the setup activity.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the current setup step has been completed, based on OS configuration.

methods.name: getPageLayoutId
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the layout resource ID for the specific wizard page.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes shared preferences when the fragment is attached to a context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the base layout and the specific page layout, embedding the page into a scroll view.

methods.name: refreshFragmentUi
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to refresh their UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components like the step status icon after the view is created.

methods.name: refreshWizardPager
methods.description: Triggers UI refresh in the parent activity's fragments.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Calls UI refresh when the fragment becomes visible.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Delegates permission request results to a helper class.
